QF.id: IV Strategies Using Interest Rate Derivatives_63

question.text: What are the eligible underlying instruments for exchange-traded interest rate derivatives in India?

answer.text: Interest rates/benchmarks (e.g., Overnight MIBOR), Government securities, T-Bills, G-Sec indices, corporate bond indices, and notional government securities as permitted by exchanges/regulators
Any bond or debt instrument including corporate bonds and commercial paper
Only bonds with residual maturity exceeding 10 years

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series IV workbook, IRF underlyings include interest rates/benchmarks such as Overnight MIBOR, Government securities, T-Bills/money market instruments, G-Sec indices, corporate bond indices, and notional government securities, as permitted by exchanges and regulators. The 2023 guidelines also enabled corporate bond index futures. The Trap: Saying "any bond or debt instrument including corporate bonds and commercial paper" is too broad — only specific instruments permitted by exchanges/regulators are eligible. Limiting underlyings to only T-Bills or only long-maturity bonds is incomplete. Note: Eligible underlyings have expanded over time; always refer to the current exchange/SEBI/RBI notifications for the latest list.
